newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian state offers stationery firm for sale.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian state offers stationery firm for sale.

text.p: The Egyptian state's Holding Company for Chemical Industries said on Monday it wanted to sell one of its subsidiaries, Graphite and Stationery Company, as part of the government's privatisation programme.
The company is on sale in total and the deadline for sealed bids is noon (0900 GMT) on September 1, it said.

In May the holding company offered to rent all or some of Graphite and Stationery's production lines to private investors. On Monday it said it had now decided on an outright sale but it did not say if it had received any offers to rent.
The Egyptian government has so far had trouble finding strategic investors to buy state companies. Sales of shares through the stock exchange have been more successful.
